blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Asean Business Advisory Council Chair Jose Ma. Concepcion III on Saturday urged big businesses to help uplift smaller businesses across Southeast Asia so they too could reap the benefits of the region’s growth. Speaking before hundreds of business executives at the Asean Investment Summit, Concepcion said the region’s prosperity must be practical and palpable, particularly for micro, small and medium enterprises (MSMEs). Concepcion, president and CEO of listed RFM Corporation, said this was especially important as many MSMEs struggle amid macroeconomic headwinds. “I don’t think this event should just be for big business. It should be inclusive,” he said. […]... Keep on reading: Asean test for big business: Help uplift MSMEs, too
